_comment: THE RADIOACTIVE DUMP (#285), the second frontier region. Spec: docs/radioactive_dump_spec.md.
Somewhere past the demolition yard, someone buried the things nobody would take. Not a crater and
not a science-fiction wasteland - a landfill with drums in it.
It exists because Powah is unstartable in this world: every non-circular route to uraninite runs
through an ore whose biome modifiers gate on #minecraft:is_overworld, and this mod ships no entry
for that tag by owner ruling (2026-08-20). Rather than open that door, the material is FOUND.
SURFACE UNCHANGED, as the yard's is. Identity comes from what is scattered on top, never from
re-surfacing: the reclamation ladder and encroachment both ride on the coarse-dirt surface rule.
Stained Ground is the one qualification and is placed as a feature rather than as a surface rule.
HOSTILE SPAWNS ON, the same set as the yard (owner, 2026-08-22). Consistent with the only other
frontier region, and it gives V1 some teeth while radiation is deferred to Mekanism - see section
6 of the spec for why there is no radiation here yet.
EFFECTS ARE ITS OWN, not the yard's. They shipped byte-identical to demolition_yard's and review
of #286 caught it: the two frontier regions were indistinguishable at range, which undercuts the
one thing V1 has to do without radiation - make arriving unmistakable. A sallow yellow-green
haze against the yard's grey, with grass and foliage sickened to match the ground.
